rules.title: San Francisco just cause eviction
rules.requirement: A landlord must have one of 17 listed just causes, as the dominant motive, to evict a tenant from a unit covered by the Rent Ordinance. Expiration of the lease or a change in ownership is not just cause.
rules.key_value: 17 just causes; landlord must show dominant motive
rules.coverage_conditions: Units covered by the Rent Ordinance, including post-1979 units and Costa-Hawkins tenancies that are exempt only from rent limits
rules.exemptions: Some tenancies regulated by another government agency
rules.quoted_span: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction.

notes: Relocation payment amounts (37.9C, 37.9A) are on D082/D083 and attach to this rule; page gives no effective date.
